# PDF dependencies

- jsPDF 4.2.1, distributed from the official npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/jspdf . License: `jspdf-LICENSE.txt`. The UMD file is used only for text-based local PDF generation.
- DejaVu Sans from the system font package. License: `DejaVu-LICENSE.txt`. Embedded in generated PDFs for readable Unicode text.

Both are served locally. Applicant entries are not transmitted to a PDF service.
